crossRefs.note: Therefore it is said in the book of the Wars of Yahweh, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,
that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city…
Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases…

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;
translations.bsb: That is why the poets say: “Come to Heshbon, let it be rebuilt; let the city of Sihon be restored.
translations.kjv: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
translations.asv: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come ye to Heshbon; Let the city of Sihon be built and established:
